narr: Monsoon moisture increased again over northern Arizona which allowed thunderstorms to develop over parts of northern Arizona. Strong winds hit the Prescott area in the afternoon and there was flash flooding in southern Yavapai County late in the evening.
ev: The Agua Fria River near Cordes Junction rose 2.2 feet between 1100 PM on July 22 and midnight on July 23. The water remained elevated for about 12 hours.
Black Canyon Creek near Cleator rose to 2.92 feet (1026 CFS).
lsr: Black Canyon Creek near Cleator gage increased to 2.92 ft. and 1026 cfs.
Corrects previous flash flood report from 3 ESE Cordes Junction. AFMA3 increased to 4.06 ft. and 71.2 cfs.
